data.name: Brainrot Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Fight your way through the endless waves of newer-gen memes by using older memes as your weapons. How long can you keep defeating them until your own brain turns to mush?

This brand-new indie game combines characters that you recognize from popular media and memes with the classic roguelike game genre to ensure of a classic yet modern experience.

Enemies:

What enemies lie behind this world of infinite spawning brainrots/newer memes? Find out as you advance through the waves and discover stronger faster and bulkier enemies. Play against the likes of Tung Tung Tung Sahur, 67 and other enemies that will try to stop you on your way to your high score!

Improvements:

Once you've gathered enough Doge Coins during your playthrough, you can use them to upgrade your stats like damage, max health and speed! See how far you can come after each upgrade.

Weapons:

Do you still remember the memes from back in the day? Use various weapons like Nyan-Cat, Trollface and other popular memes from quite a long time ago (yes, you're old) to your advantage. Keep upgrading them by gaining XP to keep up with the growing strength of your opponents.

Other stuff:

Brainrot Survivors features an all original soundtrack, cool sound effects and silly art!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
